name: EPIC 203503116
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 2, 17.0 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,332 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 0.89 solar masses and 17.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,225 K at its surface.
